text: Need a way to implement disaster recovery of agent session ending suddenly, which can happen when using a remote server or if the power gets shut off.  This may involve a combination of agent harness improvements and backlogit tooling.  Need to perform adequate research and analysis to understand what this feature entails.
Internal lifecycle hooks for validation, cascade, and enforcement
External system hooks with prioritized notification push support for Slack, Teams, and webhooks

When AdoptItem rewrites an artifact's ID and renames its file, other artifacts whose frontmatter references the old ID (e.g. parent_id, dependencies) are not updated. Stale edges reappear on next rehydration. Need a cross-artifact frontmatter reference rewrite step in AdoptItem that scans all artifacts for references to the old ID and updates them atomically.
